iti111:1.1: vuttaṃ hetaṃ bhagavatā. vuttamarahatā’ti me sutaṃ:
iti111:2.1: sampannasīlā bhikkhave viharatha, sampannapātimokkhā. pātimokkhasaṃvarasaṃvutā viharatha ācāragocarasampannā aṇumattesu vajjesu bhayadassāvī, samādāya sikkhatha sikkhāpadesu.
iti111:3.1: sampannasīlānaṃ bhikkhave viharataṃ sampannapātimokkhānaṃ pātimokkhasaṃvarasaṃvutānaṃ viharataṃ ācāragocarasampannānaṃ aṇumattesu vajjesu bhayadassāvīnaṃ samādāya sikkhataṃ sikkhāpadesu, kissa bhikkhave uttariṃ karaṇīyaṃ?
iti111:4.1: carato ce’pi bhikkhave bhikkhuno abhijjhā vigatā hoti, vyāpādo vigato hoti, thinamiddhaṃ vigataṃ hoti, uddhaccakukkuccaṃ vigataṃ hoti, vicikicchā pahīṇā hoti, āraddhaṃ hoti viriyaṃ asallīnaṃ, upaṭṭhitā sati asammuṭṭhā, passaddho kāyo asāraddho, samāhitaṃ cittaṃ ekaggaṃ,
iti111:4.2: carampi bhikkhave bhikkhu evaṃbhūto ātāpī ottappī satataṃ samitaṃ āraddhaviriyo pahitatto’ti vuccati.
iti111:5.1: ṭhitassa ce’pi bhikkhave bhikkhuno abhijjhā vigatā hoti, vyāpādo vigato hoti, thinamiddhaṃ vigato hoti, uddhaccakukkuccaṃ vigato hoti, vicikicchā pahīṇā hoti, āraddhaṃ hoti viriyaṃ asallīnaṃ, upaṭṭhitā sati asammuṭṭhā, passaddho kāyo asāraddho, samāhitaṃ cittaṃ ekaggaṃ,
iti111:5.2: ṭhito’pi, bhikkhave bhikkhu evambhūto ātāpī ottāpī satataṃ samitaṃ āraddhaviriyo pahitatto’ti vuccati.
iti111:6.1: nisinnassa ce’pi bhikkhave bhikkhuno abhijjhā vigatā hoti, vyāpādo vigato hoti, thinamiddhaṃ vigataṃ hoti, uddhaccakukkuccaṃ vigataṃ hoti, vicikicchā pahīṇā hoti, āraddhaṃ hoti viriyaṃ asallīnaṃ, upaṭṭhitā sati asammuṭṭhā, passaddho kāyo asāraddho, samāhitaṃ cittaṃ ekaggaṃ,
iti111:6.2: nisinno’pi bhikkhave bhikkhu evambhūto ātāpī ottappī satataṃ samitaṃ āraddhaviriyo pahitatto’ti vuccati.
iti111:7.1: sayānassa ce’pi bhikkhave bhikkhuno jāgarassa abhijjhā vigatā hoti, vyāpādo vigato hoti, thinamiddhaṃ vigataṃ hoti, uddhaccakukkuccaṃ vigataṃ hoti, vicikicchā pahīṇā hoti, āraddhaṃ hoti viriyaṃ asallīnaṃ, upaṭṭhitā sati asammuṭṭhā, passaddho kāyo asāraddho, samāhitaṃ cittaṃ ekaggaṃ.
iti111:7.2: sayāno’pi bhikkhave bhikkhu jāgaro evambhūto ātāpī ottappī satataṃ samitaṃ āraddhaviriyo pahitatto’ti vuccatī’ti.
iti111:11.1: ayampi attho vutto bhagavatā. iti me sutanti.
